basic_details.job_title: IndiaAI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 7 Deputy Manager, Assistant Manager and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The India AI Division of Digital India Corporation, the Independent Business Division set up by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) to implement the India AI mission, has invited applications purely on Contract/Consolidated basis for 7 positions in 5 posts: Deputy Manager / Manager – Administration and Operations (1), Assistant Manager – Future Skill (3), Deputy Manager / Manager – Finance (1), Manager / Deputy Manager – Communications (1) and Deputy General Manager – Future Skills (1). The place of posting is New Delhi, transferable to project locations of IndiaAI.

how_to_apply: Apply online at the portal given in the notice: https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/.
Submit the application by 10/12/2026, the last date for submission of application.

If you are already in regular or contractual employment under Central / State Government, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies, apply through proper channel or attach a No Objection Certificate from your employer with the application. The notice also allows producing the No Objection Certificate at the time of interview.

The notice says the details can be downloaded from the official websites of DIC, NeGD and MeitY: www.dic.gov.in, www.negd.gov.in and www.meity.gov.in. For queries, contact the HR Division, India AI Division, 4th Floor, Electronics Niketan 6-CGO, Complex Lodhi Road, New Delhi – 110003, or email [email protected].
important_instructions: The engagement is purely on Contract/Consolidated basis and is purely temporary in nature for the project of India AI. Appointees shall not derive any right or claim for permanent appointment at India AI or on any vacancy existing or advertised in future. IndiaAI reserves the right to fill all or some or none of the positions advertised without assigning any reason. IndiaAI reserves the right not to select any of the candidates without assigning any reason. IndiaAI reserves the right to terminate the appointments of all positions with a notice of one month or without any notice by paying one month's salary in lieu of the notice period. The maximum age shall be as on the last date of receipt of the applications. The place of posting shall be in New Delhi but transferable to project locations of IndiaAI as per existing policy of IndiaAI.

content_sections.heading: About IndiaAI
content_sections.text: IndiaAI is the India AI Independent Business Division that MeitY has established under Digital India Corporation to implement the India AI mission. The mission, as the notice describes it, aims to build an ecosystem for AI innovation through computing access, data quality, indigenous AI capabilities, AI talent, industry collaboration, startup risk capital, socially impactful AI projects and ethical AI. Digital India Corporation (formerly Media Lab Asia) was set up by MeitY, Government of India, and has several Independent Business Divisions, including NeGD, MyGov, Bhashini, ISM, IndiaAI and MSH. The office is at Electronics Niketan, 6, CGO Complex Lodhi Road, New Delhi – 110003.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The five posts carry 7 positions in total. All of them serve the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission, according to the job descriptions. The notice prints no category-wise break-up and no pay per post.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each post has its own qualification and experience, shown below as the notice prints them. The notice prints no age limit; it says only that the maximum age shall be as on the last date of receipt of the applications. Essential: Bachelor's degree in any discipline, with at least 5 - 6 years of relevant professional experience. Desirable: relevant experience in administration, operations, programme coordination, MIS management, documentation, or project support. Advantage: experience in government projects, public-sector organizations, PMUs, or large-scale development programmes. Also listed: experience in event management, venue and logistic coordination; experience in drafting notes, preparing presentation, dashboard etc. Essential: a relevant graduate or postgraduate qualification in management, public administration, engineering, technology, social sciences, or a related discipline. Advantage: 2+ relevant experience in project coordination, programme management, government initiatives, skilling, education, or technology-related programmes. Essential: Graduate preferably (B.Com)/MBA in Finance, or an equivalent relevant qualification from a recognized institution. Candidates with knowledge on GFR and Government Procurement rules may be preferred. Experience: minimum 5 - 6 years in financial management, budgeting, procurement, or program finance. Experience with public-sector, government, or social-sector organizations is preferred. Knowledge of Tally and other accounting software. Experience in fund utilization monitoring, financial reporting, audit coordination, vendor payments and contract-related financial processes will be an advantage. Skill areas listed: financial planning and management (budgeting, expenditure tracking, fund utilisation, financial analysis); financial reporting, compliance and risk management (reconciliation, audits, procurement, contract finance); MIS and stakeholder coordination (advanced MS Excel, financial reporting tools, coordination with government agencies and implementing partners). Skill areas listed: strategic communication and content development (editorial and presentation skills); digital marketing, outreach and campaign management; public relations, brand management and stakeholder coordination. content_sections.heading: IndiaAI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Job purpose: the Administration and Operations Expert will provide day-to-day administrative, operational and coordination support across the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission, maintain programme documentation, support events and outreach, and assist in operating the national dashboard and Management Information System (MIS). Location: Delhi NCR. Provide day-to-day administrative and operational coordination across the workstreams of the Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. Facilitate internal coordination, administrative approvals, meeting arrangements, scheduling, and follow-up on action points. Maintain programme records, official correspondence, project documentation, meeting minutes, trackers, and other administrative records. Assist in preparing agendas, briefing notes, presentations, reports, and documentation for internal reviews and stakeholder meetings. Coordinate workshops, conferences, consultations, training programmes, outreach activities and other events; arrange venue and all logistics; coordinate with the media team on branding/outreach at the venue. Provide operational support for stakeholder engagement involving government departments, academic institutions, implementation partners, and other agencies. Support the operational administration of the national dashboard and MIS: data coordination, updating records, tracking submissions, following up with stakeholders. Coordinate with technical teams and programme stakeholders for timely and accurate information for dashboard updates and management reporting. Monitor pending activities, maintain operational trackers, follow up with teams on deliverables, and coordinate with states and their departments for execution of activities. Assist in collecting, compiling, validating and consolidating programme information and periodic progress reports. Support logistics, documentation and other administrative requirements for smooth functioning of the PMU. Identify operational bottlenecks and escalate issues requiring intervention by programme leadership. Ensure proper record management, information accuracy, and adherence to established administrative procedures. Undertake other administrative and operational responsibilities assigned by the reporting officer. Job purpose: the Assistant Manager will serve as a shared resource for the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and the AI Talent Mission, supporting programme implementation, administrative clearances, interdepartmental coordination and execution of assigned key result areas (KRAs), working closely with the designated Project Manager. Location: Delhi NCR. Support implementation and coordination of schemes and initiatives under the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. Facilitate administrative approvals, internal clearances, file processing, and coordination with divisions and government stakeholders.
